name: Brookline
title: Brookline MA Bulky Item Pickup: $20 Items, $65 Mattresses
meta_description: Brookline bulky item pickup: $20 furniture, $30 appliances and electronics, $65 per mattress. Book a week ahead online. Rules, Tuesday pickups, sources.
intro: Brookline collects big items at the curb for a fee if you're on Town trash service. Book and pay a week ahead online or at Town Hall: $20 for furniture or a rug, $30 for an appliance or electronics, $65 for each mattress or box spring. Here's what each option takes, what it costs, and where we got it.

quick_answers.q: How do I schedule a bulky item pickup in Brookline?
quick_answers.a: Register on the Town's Accela permit portal and request a pickup, or pay in person at Town Hall. Book and pay at least one week before collection; up to four items per week.

quick_answers.q: How much is bulky item pickup in Brookline, MA?
quick_answers.a: $20 per special item such as wood or upholstered furniture or a rug, $30 per electronic or white good, and $65 per mattress or box spring. Online card payments carry a service fee.

quick_answers.q: What day is bulk trash pickup in Brookline?
quick_answers.a: Furniture put out as trash, like desks and chairs, goes on your regular trash day. Mattresses, electronics, metal and white goods are collected on Tuesdays. Your confirmation email gives each item's date.
Construction or remodel material, car parts, gym equipment and pianos, plus apartment, attic or basement clean-outs. The Town says to use a private permitted waste hauler for those.

listings.name: Mass Save refrigerator and freezer recycling ($75 rebate)
items_accepted: Working refrigerators (inside size 10 to 30 cubic feet)
Working freezers (inside size 10 to 30 cubic feet)
Working dehumidifiers ($30 rebate, only with a fridge or freezer pickup)
items_not_accepted: Refrigerators or freezers that don't work (must be plugged in and cooling at pickup)
Units smaller than 10 or larger than 30 cubic feet inside
listings.condition_rules: Must be an inefficient, working unit that is plugged in, cooling, and empty at pickup; disconnect any water line first. You must own it and it must be at your residence or business. All doors must be removed before placing it outside. Maximum two units per equipment type per electric account per calendar year. Only for Massachusetts electric customers whose Mass Save Sponsor is Cape Light Compact, Eversource, National Grid or Unitil.
listings.stairs_inside: Inside pickup only where there is one flight of stairs or fewer (per Mass Save); with more stairs you must make the item accessible for outside pickup.
listings.lead_time: Not stated, check with them. Rebate processing takes 6 to 8 weeks after pickup.
listings.cost: No-cost pickup plus a $75 rebate (pickup must happen between January 1 and December 31, 2026).
listings.service_area: Massachusetts electric customers whose Mass Save Sponsor is Cape Light Compact, Eversource, National Grid or Unitil. Check that your electric utility is one of these.
listings.notes: Have your electric account number handy when scheduling, per Mass Save.

items_not_accepted: Hazardous materials such as certain paints, chemicals, asbestos and medical waste
